**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
{oxc parser message}
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Fix the syntax error at the reported position (unclosed tag, stray brace, missing parenthesis). In the editor TypeScript's own syntax error is shown instead (analyzeFile drops RV1000 when TS reports syntax errors).

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const A = () => <div>;
```

```tsx prefer
export const A = () => <div />;
```

## When it is reported

Text comes from oxc verbatim; not Rivet-authored.
